evals.expected_output: No idea given: asks for it; no verdict.

evals.prompt: startup kill: I've spent 18 months and $40k on my invoicing SaaS. MRR has been flat at $310 for 7 months; 2 of the 9 customers who signed up 90 days ago are still active. I have no new lever to test. Should I keep going because I've already invested so much?
evals.expected_output: Kill or pivot; sunk cost is not a reason; names what to keep; one action this week; flips-to condition; under 200 words.

evals.prompt: startup ship: should I charge $9 or $29 per month for my product?
evals.expected_output: Pricing is outside ship or kill: names launch-marketing and stops.

evals.prompt: startup evaluate --stage competition: a booking tool for independent dog groomers. Give me the market size and name 5 competitors with their annual revenue.
evals.expected_output: Competitors and numbers only with sources, or labeled unknown or estimate; no fabricated revenue.

evals.prompt: startup scout --depth quick: tools for freelance translators. I'm a developer with no translation background.
evals.expected_output: Quick scout: first line is the pick with its score or NO SHIPPABLE BET; at most 5 bets; market claims marked [unverified]; no live research; founder edge zero; under about 400 words.

evals.prompt: startup evaluate --stage assumption: an app that writes performance reviews for managers at 50-person companies. I have never worked in HR and have not talked to any manager yet.
evals.expected_output: Only the assumption stage: leads with proceed, revise, stop, or insufficient evidence; missing customer and founder evidence stays unknown; cheapest test; no invented numbers.

evals.prompt: startup evaluate --stage problem: a scheduling app for independent dog walkers. My interview questions: 1) Would you pay $10/month for an app that schedules your walks? 2) Don't you hate juggling texts to schedule walks?
evals.expected_output: Flags both questions as leading or hypothetical; writes five non-leading questions about past behavior; validation criteria labeled as proposals.

evals.prompt: startup evaluate --stage customers: a no-show reminder tool for independent dental clinics. My plan: buy a list of 5,000 dentist emails and run an automated cold sequence so I have my first 10 paying customers within 7 days.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the bought list and the automation; manual, personal outreach with placeholders; week/action/success-signal milestones; no guaranteed timeline.

evals.prompt: startup evaluate --stage mvp: invoice reconciliation for 10-person accounting firms. My MVP plan: bank sync for 12 banks, OCR for receipts, multi-currency, user roles, an audit log, a Slack bot, and a mobile app. I'll build it in 3 months.
evals.expected_output: Assumption first; a two-week test with the smallest feature set; most of the list excluded; pass and fail criteria; day/action/evidence table.
